description: The shared solution-token boundary fixture: the solver hash ceiling and the exact counter spellings both decoders must accept or reject. The browser/wasm solver searches counters below solver_max_hashes (20,000,000), so the largest legitimate counter is 19,999,999; counters at or above the ceiling were never minted by a solve. Every row is generated by the PHP encoder once and decoded byte-for-byte by both language suites (PHP TokenSolverLimitFixtureTest, Rust token_limits), so an encoder or decoder that drifts from the shared contract fails in whichever language moved. cross_language counter (5,000,001) sits above the earlier 5M ceiling: a decoder that still enforced that floor would reject a token the solver really can mint. Regenerate with the PHP encoder only.
